# Website v2 Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Rebuild the missing-hours.app landing page as the "problem first" v2 (new structure, copy, logo, real app icons, SEO) on branch `site-v2`, previewable without touching the live site.

**Architecture:** Static GitHub Pages site. Today's generated files (`index.html`, `assets/site.css`, `assets/design.js`) become hand-edited source; the Claude Design converter is archived. A dependency-free Node script `_design/check.mjs` is the test suite: it parses the built pages as text and asserts structure, copy rules, assets and SEO data. A second script builds an artifact-ready preview copy.

**Tech Stack:** HTML, CSS, vanilla JS (existing `assets/runtime.js` mini runtime), Node 18+ for scripts only, headless Microsoft Edge for the OG image. No npm dependencies.

**Spec:** `_design/specs/2026-11-25-site-v2-design.md` (read it first; copy source for every section is the concept artifact https://claude.ai/artifact/9roHrPSL4jityqjmW1cmZB, variant A).

## Global Constraints

- Branch `site-v2` only. Never push `gh-pages`, never merge into `main`/`beta`. Going live is Task 8 and needs the user's explicit OK.
- No new third-party requests: allowed external origins are `api.github.com` (release lookup) and `github.com` links. Fonts stay self-hosted. No cookies, no analytics.
- No claims the app can't back: no "open source", no "signed installer", no external statistics, no automatic summing of picked blocks.
- App facts: Windows 10 and 11; starts with Windows; keeps 30 days; zoom 15/10/5 min; detects breaks; only goes online to check for a new version (GitHub, or the Microsoft Store for Store installs).
- Logo red `#e5484d` only for the one stroke, never as a fill.
- Copy: plain English, active voice, no em-dash asides; H1 stays "Find your missing hours."
- Commits: Conventional Commits, trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`.

## Review Focus

1. Dark mode: the dark logo variant and every new section must read correctly with `prefers-color-scheme: dark` (check.mjs asserts both logo files are referenced with a dark media switch; visual check in Task 7).
2. Phone width 375 px: no horizontal scroll with the new sections, the FAQ and the app views (visual check in Task 7 at 375 px).
3. JavaScript off or `runtime.js` failing: every section's copy and the app views' initial state must be in the static HTML (check.mjs reads raw HTML, Task 1/4 tests).
4. GitHub API unavailable (rate limit, offline, artifact preview CSP): every `a[data-download]` keeps a working fallback `href` to the v`FALLBACK_VERSION` installer (check.mjs, Task 1).
5. Keyboard and reduced motion: FAQ uses native `<details>`; any new motion respects `prefers-reduced-motion` (check.mjs asserts `<details>`/`<summary>` count equals FAQ entries, Task 6).

### Task 1: Freeze the export, add the check script

**Files:**
- Move: `_design/build.mjs`, `_design/fixes.mjs`, `_design/Site5.dc.html` → `_design/v1/`
- Create: `_design/check.mjs`
- Modify: `README.md` (Layout table + "Change the site" now: edit `index.html`/`assets/*` directly, run `node _design/check.mjs`, preview, commit; v1 converter archived in `_design/v1/`, tag `site-v1`)
- Modify: `index.html`, `assets/site.css`, `assets/design.js`: drop the "Generated by… Don't edit" banners.

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `node _design/check.mjs` exits 0 and prints `check: ok (<n> checks)`, or exits 1 listing each failed check. Internally `const checks = []; function check(name, fn)`; pages read with `fs.readFileSync`. Later tasks add checks to this file.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the base checks** in `_design/check.mjs`:
  - `assets exist`: every `src=`/`href=` in `index.html`, `404.html`, `imprint/index.html`, `privacy/index.html` that is relative or starts with `/` resolves to a file in the repo.
  - `no design syntax`: no `{{`, `<sc-`, `<dc-`, `/_blob/` in `index.html`.
  - `downloads have fallback`: every `<a … data-download …>` has `href` matching `/releases/download/v\d+\.\d+\.\d+/Missing-Hours-Setup-\d+\.\d+\.\d+-win-x64\.exe$/`.
  - `external origins`: every absolute `http(s)://` URL in `src=` attributes or in `assets/*.js` fetch calls is `https://api.github.com/...`.
  - `no generated banner`: `index.html` does not contain `Generated by _design/build.mjs`.
- [ ] **Step 2: Run** `node _design/check.mjs` → Expected: FAIL only on `no generated banner`.
- [ ] **Step 3:** `git mv` the converter files into `_design/v1/`, remove the banners, update `README.md`.
- [ ] **Step 4: Run** `node _design/check.mjs` → Expected: `check: ok`.
- [ ] **Step 5: Commit** `refactor(site): hand-maintained source, archive the v1 converter, add check script`

### Task 4: New structure and copy (variant A)

**Files:**
- Modify: `index.html` (sections), `assets/site.css` (styles for the new sections, reusing existing tokens and `.beat` patterns), `assets/design.js` (remove the logic for the four use-case tabs and anything only they used; keep hero view, day arrows, zoom, live timer)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the runtime's binding attributes (`data-dc`, `data-dc-text`, `data-dc-if`, `data-dc-on`) as they are; any binding left in the HTML must resolve in `renderVals()`.
- Produces: sections in this order with these `id`s and H2 texts (H1 in the hero):
  1. `#top` hero — eyebrow `Automatic time tracking for Windows`, H1 `Find your missing hours.`, subline `When you fill in your timesheet, an hour is often missing. That hour is work you did and never billed. Missing Hours writes your day down on its own, app by app, so you get it back.`, CTA + `Free · No account · Stays on your PC`, the existing live app view.
  2. `#cost` — H2 `Forgotten hours cost real money.`; figure `$4,300` with caption `a year, if one hour a week goes missing at $90 an hour. Change the numbers to yours; the gap is rarely zero.`
  3. `#how` — H2 `How automatic time tracking works here`; three steps as in the concept.
  4. `#example` — H2 `From your day to your timesheet`; **one day** (Thursday, Baker Ltd blocks highlighted, reader adds them up, total shown as `4h 25m`, consistent with today's data for Thu 19 Nov); text: pick the blocks that belong to a project, add them up, write the entry (timesheet or invoice).
  5. `#records` — H2 `What it records, and what it never does`; two lists as in the concept.
  6. `#any-day` — H2 `Any day, rough or precise.`; existing zoom/day-arrow demo; text includes the breaks sentence.
  7. `#alongside` — H2 `Keep your time tracker. This is where you look things up.`
  8. `#privacy` — H2 `No account. No cloud.`; text: `Everything stays on your PC, and recordings delete themselves after 30 days. The only time it goes online is to check for a new version (on GitHub, or through the Microsoft Store if you installed it from there).` plus the 30-day retention visual.
  9. `#free` — H2 `Free, with the code in the open.`; includes the "Made by Sebastian Wolf, a UX designer…" note.
  10. `#faq` — Task 6 fills it; leave the section with its H2 `Questions` here.
  11. `#download` — unchanged closing CTA.
